audiences.heading: Who this course is for, and who it is not for
audiences.intro: Idaho is specific about what a defensive driving course does. We would rather tell you now than after you pay.

items.label: Points on your record
items.heading: Take three points off, once every three years
items.body: Complete an approved course and ITD removes three points from your Idaho driving record. Once every three years. Your citation must be paid first, and the conviction itself stays on the record.

items.label: 55 and older
items.heading: Ask your insurer before you enroll
items.body: Some Idaho insurers reduce premiums for drivers 55 and older who complete a defensive driving course. Your insurer decides whether this course qualifies and how much. Call them first; then take the course if the answer is yes.

items.label: Hoping to clear a ticket
items.heading: This course does not clear a ticket or reduce a fine
items.body: Idaho has no traffic-school program that voids a citation. The fine is paid, the conviction records, and then the course takes three points off. If you are looking for a way out of the ticket itself, talk to the court.

curriculum.heading: What is in the six hours

steps.heading: How it works, start to certificate

benefits.headline: Three points removed, once every three years
benefits.body: Idaho's administrative rule for defensive driving courses provides that three points may be removed from a driver's record on completion of an approved course, and that points may be removed this way only once every three years.

benefits.headline: The citation is paid first, and the conviction stays
benefits.body: The reduction applies to points, not to the citation. Any outstanding citation must be paid before ITD applies the reduction, and the conviction remains on your record.

benefits.headline: A certificate you send to ITD yourself
benefits.body: Idaho has no provider reporting system. You receive a certificate on completion and deliver it to ITD by email or mail. ITD applies the reduction to your record.

faqs.q: How many points does the course take off?
faqs.a: Three, once every three years, under IDAPA 39.02.71. The conviction itself stays on your record.

faqs.q: Will this course get my ticket dropped or my fine reduced?
faqs.a: No. Idaho has no traffic-school program that voids a citation. You pay the citation, the conviction records, and then the course removes three points. If you want to contest the ticket, that is a conversation with the court.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay the ticket before the points come off?
faqs.a: Yes. ITD applies the reduction only after any outstanding citation is paid.

faqs.q: How long does the course take?
faqs.a: Six hours, measured by module timers, at your own pace. There is no state deadline. Most people finish across two or three sittings.
No. Twelve modules, then one 25-question final exam.

faqs.q: What is the final exam like?
faqs.a: Twenty-five questions, twenty correct to pass. Unlimited retakes with no waiting period, and after every attempt you see which questions you got right and wrong.

faqs.q: How do I get my certificate to ITD?
faqs.a: Email it to ddc@itd.idaho.gov or mail it to ITD DMV, PO Box 7129, Boise, ID 83707-1129. We attach the instructions to your certificate email. Idaho has no provider reporting system, so this step is yours.

faqs.q: I am 55 or older. Will my insurance go down?
faqs.a: It might. Some Idaho insurers reduce premiums for drivers 55 and older who complete a defensive driving course, but your insurer decides whether this course qualifies and by how much. Ask them before you enroll if that is your reason.
